Name: Phineas
Dialog: I gotta hand it to ya, Buford, I had my doubts...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (cont'd) ...but the design specs are promising. I know what we're gonna do today! Build a Bread Bowl—

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen, screams)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mom?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, where're you guys... We're comin' back after this, right?

Name: Linda
Dialog: My wedding ring! It slipped off down the drain!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Good thing we installed a tracking chip after the llama incident.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Uh, I can see it right here, darling. Just need to give it a little... (twists, but some water squirts on him.) Oh, dear. Oh, my.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I know what we're actually gonna do today! Find Mom's ring!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, mail from the old country! Vanessa, it's for you!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (takes the note and reads it) "Congratulations, due to your upcoming 17th birthday, you are now eligible for Drusselsteinian citizenship."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (takes the note) Oh, my little girl is all grown up! This is so exciting, Vanessa! I'll start looking for flights!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, everything you've told me about the old country is terrible. Why would you wanna go back?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Vanessa, it would be good for you to get in touch with your roots. Who knows? You might even come up with your own tragic backstory!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hmmm, I guess you're right. Maybe deeply depressed generational trauma could be fun? And I am curious about our culture.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hee hee! Yes! Pack your bags! We're going to Gimmelshtump, baby!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (looking at his tablet) Wow! Who knew one single family home needed such an extensive drainage system? What's up with this redacted area?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Your mom's ring!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmmm, it looks like it went down a wrong pipe and detoured deep into the Earth's crust. Time to get diggin'!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Poor Mom and her ring. But it looks like it's a day off from busting at least.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (exclaims) Is that an earthquake?! Is everyone okay?! Where's Perry?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Congratulations, Agent P! You've won an all-expense paid trip to... (to Carl) Drumroll, please.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Gimmelshtump!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And by a totally unrelated coincidence, Doofenshmirtz will be there. Keep an eye on him.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was no earthquake! That was Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aaaaaaah! What? Get this off! Where am I?

Name: Candace
Dialog: WHOA!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, we don't even know where that goes!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Uh, I panicked!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, she'll probably be fine. She's made of sturdy stuff.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, I can't believe they built an airport in Drusselstein. They used to just kick us out mid-flight. I'll just hail a horse if I can—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh? (gasps)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, they have ridesharing. And cell service, thank goodness.

Name: Driver
Dialog: Where to?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: The embassy, thanks. Sweet ride.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, it's all so different. When did change become legal here?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: This place doesn't seem so bad, Dad. From what you told me, sounds like Gimmelsthump needed a change.

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: So you're here for your citizenship test? Name please.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: (takes a folder) Heinz or Vanessa?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: "Heinz"?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'll take that. (takes folder) Uh, since my parents didn't show up to my birth, I'm not technically a citizen and I was never able to complete my citizenship test when I was your age. So I'm doing it now is what I'm saying.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) I was able to complete wrangling a pig, and the Humiliating Stumblegimp Dance of Contrition. But then I couldn't do the generational kickball thing, cuz, y'know, my parents don't show up for things. Anyway, honey, I must enthusiastically warn you of...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (cont'd) ...how daunting and uncomfortable these tests will be. Truly traumatizing. But you'll do great, sweetie.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I can feel my backstory building already.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb! (she falls down in a dark area) Where am I?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Mole Person
Dialog: Our surface-dwelling savior!

Name: Mole People
Dialog: (genuflecting) We're saved!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I've already been the Queen of Mars. I don't need to be the Monarch of Mole People.

Name: Mole Person
Dialog: Mole people don't take rejection well! Get her!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow! Talk about needy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace? How'd you get down here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I have no idea.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hop on! The mole people startle easily. But they will be back and in greater numbers.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I bet that right about now that Hot Tub doesn't sound so bad, does it?

Name: Announcer
Dialog: And kicking off the citizenship test is Vanessa Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Look at her hug that hog!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Next up is the Dance of Contrition, and look at her raise the roof!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (looking at a book) This is all wrong! Look, it says here that the Humiliating Dance of Contrition is now 85% less humiliating! H-How would they even calculate that?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Sure, it's a little different, but I kinda like it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no, I want you to hate it like I did! Tragedy builds character. Come on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You want culture from the old country, you go to the old people. A note? (reads the note on the door) "Heinz, in preparation for your arrival, we've taken a vacation until further notice. Give our love to Nessa, please don't call. - Mom"

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (stammers) Vanessa, you should just go, y'know, hang with your new friends, I...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No, no, it's okay. I can stay with you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I feel... I feel a big emotional bit coming on. Maybe even a power ballad.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Ah. In that case, I'll just leave you to it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If Vanessa could only see this place for what it truly is, she would finally hate it and thus benefit from that hate, like me! I can make an inator to make things the way they used to be, and then Vanessa can have her own backstories.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So what are you guys doing down here anyway?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looking for Mom's ring. And it looks like it's right behind this rock. Let's get to chipping.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I wanna get back up there to bust you. Set aside.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace, take it easy! This type of sediment is unstable!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom's ring! I found it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha ha! Got it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The good news is we found Mom's ring!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bad news is we broke the drill bit, so...

Name: Ferb
Dialog: We're trapped.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Not it!

Name: Buford
Dialog: For what?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: At some point, the food will run out, and we will be forced to make "difficult decisions".

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What?! We were all thinking it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, my Downgrade-inator! (Doof fires his inator at a car and it becomes a goat and cart.) All right! Pothole here! (He fires at a woman coming out of a clothing boutique.) Potato sacks over there!

Name: Salesman
Dialog: This is a small batch of handcrafted farm to table...

Name: Salesman
Dialog: Goat food.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! This is more like it! This is the Gimmelshtump I remember!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait 'til Vanessa sees this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (screams) Oh, Perry the Platypus! Enjoying the sights?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Oh, look, it's the kickball field! And Vanessa! Time out, Perry the Platypus, for emotional reasons. Look, look at my Nessa! She's having fun in Drusselstein! (sighs) I never had that. It's nice to see.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, line up for the generational kickball passage. Grab your loving and supportive parent and make them proud.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My parents were never there for my kickball moment. But you know what? I'm gonna be there for Vanessa. Take us down!

Name: Referee
Dialog: Now, you must kick the ball to you, and you must kick the ball back to you. This completes the test.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow!

Name: Farmer
Dialog: Oops, there goes our entire city's water supply right down our bottomless pit.

Name: Referee
Dialog: Congratulations! Just like that, you and you are Drusselstinian citizens!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm a citizen! Just like you.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Way to go, Dad.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Maybe a little change can be good. That's why I moved as far from here as I possibly could

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It hurts less when you're a citizen.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're gonna have to join the mole people! I'll become their ruler! And you guys my underlings!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, my goodness!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Linda
Dialog: What's going on out here?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, my ring! Thank you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Actually, Candace found it!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (covered in pipes) Oh, looks like you boys have beaten me to it. Good on ya, lads!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Drill... underground... mole people!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, why are you so filthy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: But... but... but... (sighs in exasperation)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, that certainly has a familiar "ring" to it!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Nothing? Nobody gets me.
